title: [tauri-apps/tauri] Fix issue #15781: AppImage GTK hook overrides an explicitly set GDK_BACKEND
description:
Fix GitHub issue #15781 in tauri-apps/tauri:
https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/issues/15781

Repo:
https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri

Expected fix target:
### Describe the bug The AppImage GTK hook exports `GDK_BACKEND=x11` unconditionally (`crates/tauri-bundler/src/bundle/linux/appimage/linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk.sh`, line 187 on `dev`). I know the history: the line comes from upstream linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk, removing it was tested once and ended in #8541-class crashes, and #11790 records the current answer as "hardcoded, override it from Rust if you need to". This report...
